verdict.rationale: The docs give a short install path: `$skill-installer linear` for curated skills, or `/plugins` in Codex CLI followed by a new session. A hands-on probe installed a skill keylessly with one command (`npx skills add openai/plugins --skill plugin-creator -a codex`) and got a valid SKILL.md, so getting a working skill quickly looks realistic. Missing for 10: a dedicated skills quickstart page (the only quickstart shown covers MCP apps), any timed evidence of the under-five-minute claim, coverage of prerequisites like installing and authenticating Codex, and hands-on confirmation that the installed skill actually runs in a session.
